contract: Each v0.7 Shield integration/e2e test binds one minimal contract-deviation counterexample (mutation) and a kill verification, per test-plan §12.2 / §1.4.3. All 14 patches apply cleanly against the current HEAD via `git apply --check`, scope contains no tests/ paths, and each patch kills its bound test node (verified: apply -> run bound node -> KILLED -> revert). The legal-Red source for each new-behaviour test is the corresponding IF stub raising NotImplementedError("IF-...") (stub contract-token failure per AC-FR0260-01); each counterexample converts that into a contract-deviating return so the bound test's assertion discriminates correct from deviating behaviour. Patches shared by two ACs (e.g. ce_guard_exit_zero for AC-FR0257-02/AC-FR0258-02, ce_unrelated_red_counted for AC-FR0260-02/05, ce_kernel_language_token for AC-FR0264-04/AC-NFR0141-02) are single-IF patches with independent per-AC manifest entries per §1.4.3.

bindings.mutation: scan_trace_gaps returns [] -> marker-only gaps silently treated as repaired (deviates from AC-FR0256-02 marker-only-stays-fail)
judge_real_coverage returns passed=True even with a non-empty excluded_sources (deviates from by=collected exclude=none)
check_parity returns all-match=True with empty mismatches even when --exit-zero is injected (deviates from parity hard gate)
check_parity accepts --exit-zero as match (deviates from AC-FR0258-02 three-place parity fail-closed)
load_guard_registry returns an empty entries tuple (zero categories) instead of the eight required (deviates from eight-category completeness)
judge_authenticity returns unrelated_nodes=() and red=legal, counting an unrelated downstream failure as the AC's legal Red (deviates from unrelated isolation)
judge_authenticity accepts a broad/no-op mutation as legal Red (deviates from AC-FR0260-05 illegal-Red rejection)
judge_authenticity returns counterexample_kill=verified with no counterexample experiment present (deviates from existing-green-requires-kill)
validate_manifest accepts a no-op patch as a valid MutationManifest instead of blocking no_selectable_diff_identity (deviates from single-AC/diff-identity)
validate_manifest accepts a tests/-scoped manifest instead of blocking tests_in_scope (deviates from frozen-tests role separation)
bindings.verification: re-verified on the landed IF-MUTATION-001 implementation (validate_manifest implemented): the node is existing-green (correctly blocks tests/-scope, status=failed with tests reason) and the patch still KILLS it (apply -> validate_manifest accepts the tests-scoped manifest -> assert result is None or status==blocked fails -> FAILED -> revert); this is the AC-FR0261-01 existing-green + counterexample_kill=verified authentication for the node classified unexpected_pass by the mechanical RED_CHECK

bindings.mutation: run_mutation_experiment returns status=passed/target_kill=verified even when the target survived (deviates from target-kill requirement)
run_mutation_experiment returns status=passed/controls=green even when a control node was hit (deviates from controls-green requirement)
resolve_adapter returns None for unknown adapter id/protocol/version instead of raising UnknownAdapterError (deviates from unknown-adapter fail-closed)
injects a forbidden `pytest` language token into tracks/kernel/__init__.py (deviates from kernel language neutrality)
injects a forbidden `pytest` language token into the kernel forbidden zone (deviates from language-invariant dual check)
check_trace_full returns status=pass with empty hard_errors, accepting a foreign candidate closure (deviates from candidate-digest consistency)
build_seal_manifest returns a fixed seal_id regardless of drifted inputs (deviates from read-only sealed baseline)
_emit_test_selected emits test.selected with adapter=None (adapter identity dropped) instead of the reference-pytest adapter audit identity (deviates from IF-ADAPTER-002 adapter execution audit)
